title.zh: xAI没签欧盟透明准则，Grok API却要在全球默认加文字水印
title.en: xAI没签欧盟透明准则，Grok API却要在全球默认加文字水印

current_state.zh: xAI updated its developer documentation to say Grok API outputs for Grok 4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3 and the Grok 4.20 models will carry invisible text watermarks by default worldwide starting November 7, including structured outputs and tool-call parameters, to satisfy EU AI Act transparency rules; developers can disable it per model only by confirming a legal exemption and assuming disclosure responsibility.
current_state.en: xAI updated its developer documentation to say Grok API outputs for Grok 4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3 and the Grok 4.20 models will carry invisible text watermarks by default worldwide starting November 7, including structured outputs and tool-call parameters, to satisfy EU AI Act transparency rules; developers can disable it per model only by confirming a legal exemption and assuming disclosure responsibility.
